channel.title: The Brussels Times
channel.description: Latest posts from The Brussels Times.

item.title: Dutch wildfire flares up again near the Belgian border
item.description: Throughout the evening and overnight, crews worked to extinguish the flames and cool the ground to prevent the fire from reigniting.

item.title: France: Six people injured in shooting by masked gunmen
item.description: Investigators believe the shooting was likely linked to a settling of scores in the criminal scene.

item.title: EU blames Ceuta migration crisis on smuggling networks without clear evidence
item.description: "The EU is currently negotiating a strategic comprehensive partnership agreement with Morocco."

item.title: Doctor from Gaza can leave for studies if Belgium requests it, Israel says
item.description: “The departure from Gaza is facilitated upon the submission of a request by a third country willing to receive the individual."

item.title: Several people stabbed in central London – woman arrested
item.description: A 47-year-old woman has been arrested on suspicion of possession of an offensive weapon and assault.

item.title: Two young Belgian hikers struck by lightning in French Pyrenees
item.description: One of the two Belgians, a 14-year-old boy, suffered a cardiac arrest after being struck by lightning.

item.title: Drone spotted at Leipzig Airport was fitted with 'explosive device'
item.description: Several cargo flights and one passenger flight were diverted after the incident.

item.title: Gianni Infantino calls emergency FIFA meeting on Wednesday
item.description: The FIFA president has called an emergency meeting of the body's senior leadership in Rabat on Wednesday after comments by Arsène Wenger increased pressure on him.

item.title: Wildfire in Netherlands reveals possible Second World War shells
item.description: Dutch bomb disposal experts were called in on Tuesday after a wildfire in a nature reserve in Limburg uncovered what appear to be Second World War explosives.

item.title: Trump: Either the Strait of Hormuz 'will open very soon', or Iran will be struck 'very hard'
item.description: Tensions in the Strait of Hormuz, which has become a major flashpoint in the war in the Middle East, remain high.

item.title: Crime, terrorism and unrest: US issues travel advisory warning about the dangers of Belgium
item.description: The US State Department has advised Americans travelling to Belgium to "stay aware of [their] surroundings".

item.title: WHO hopeful as multiple Ebola drugs trials get underway
item.description: Promising early results from trials of Ebola medicines and vaccines offer hope in the Democratic Republic of Congo.

item.title: Oil prices rise as Trump gives Iran 'last chance' to find agreement
item.description: The US president said that negotiations with Iran had taken place – though Tehran denies this.

item.title: Nearly 160 migrants rescued while attempting to cross the Channel
item.description: It is one of the largest rescue efforts in the North Sea since migrants began crossing the Channel in 2018.

item.title: Wildfire in Dutch Limburg still not extinguished with 100 hectares burned
item.description: Dutch authorities do not expect the large wildfire in the De Rosmolen nature reserve in northern Limburg to be extinguished before the end of Tuesday morning.

item.title: Major wildfire breaks out in Dutch Limburg province
item.description: Dutch rail operator NS has halted train services between Nijmegen and Venray because of the fire.

item.title: Belgian research group issues advice on pregnancies after Ozempic use
item.description: Until now, doctors, midwives and other healthcare professionals had very little guidance on the issue.

item.title: France: 375 people arrested in connection to wildfires
item.description: Out of the 375 people arrested by the French authorities, 142 were minors.

item.title: Iran war: New negotiations to take place on Monday, says Trump
item.description: On Sunday, an Iranian parliament member indicated that efforts were underway to revive negotiations with the US.

item.title: Two new large fires break out in Spain
item.description: This year’s weather conditions have been especially favourable for fires.
